landing: Memberships, payments and check-ins for your gym, in one place
today1: Open GymBhai and see your day: check-ins, money in, and who owes you
today2: A to-do list for the desk: payments to approve, people to call back
members: One tap shows who is expiring, who has expired and who owes money
add1: Add a member and take the first payment in one form
add2: Cash, eSewa, Khalti, Fonepay or bank: the money goes straight to you
add3: Every payment gets a receipt you can print or share
door: Check members in at the door, by QR code or by name
app1: Every member gets your gym's app, with their own door QR code
app2: They renew from their phone and pay your eSewa or bank QR directly
app3: The request reaches your desk instantly. Check your wallet, then approve
app4: Their membership is renewed. Nobody had to come to the desk
reports: Income, expenses, profit and renewals, worked out every month
nepali: In English or नेपाली, with Bikram Sambat dates
